title: Your AI agent is grading its own homework
description: In fabrika the agent that writes the code never approves it. A separate reviewer posts a verdict bound to the exact head SHA, so a new push invalidates the old approval.

scenes.text: Your AI agent is grading its *own homework.*

scenes.before: The agent that wrote the code says it looks good.
scenes.after: A *separate reviewer* signs off on one exact commit.

scenes.caption: The verdict is bound to the *head SHA*
scenes.title: pull request #10592

lines.out: [bad]✗ verdict is for an old head[/bad]

scenes.text: Push again, *review again.* No stale approvals.
